name: native Map and Set held in an any literal stay live
source: function main(): void { const m = new Map<string, number>(); m.set("a", 1); const o: any = { m }; m.set("b", 2); console.log(o.m.size, o.m.get("b")); const s = new Set<number>(); s.add(1); const p: any = { s }; s.add(2); console.log(p.s.size, p.s.has(2)); }
